            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.item_emb.weight)

            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.item_emb.weight)

        self.residual_ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_units, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, hidden_units),

        nn.init.zeros_(self.residual_ffn[2].weight)

    def encode"

          "replace": "    def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
